questions.question: Where can administrators manage Platform Analytics Solution content, widgets, dashboards, and diagnose errors from a single location?

explanation.correct: From a single console, administrators can manage Platform Analytics Solution content, manage Performance Analytics widgets and dashboards, diagnose and resolve errors, view usage analytics, modify configuration settings and access ServiceNow help.

wrongAnswers.explanation: System Properties is for general platform settings, not PA-specific management.
Dashboard Editor is for creating/editing individual dashboards, not comprehensive PA management.
KPI Composer is for designing PA solutions, not for administrative management.

source.excerpt: From a single console, administrators can manage Platform Analytics Solution content, manage Performance Analytics widgets and dashboards, diagnose and resolve errors, view usage analytics, modify configuration settings and access ServiceNow help.

questions.question: What does Spotlight help users accomplish in Performance Analytics?

options.text: Identify and rank records of interest based on multiple weighted criteria
Highlight specific time periods on charts

explanation.correct: Use Spotlight to identify and rank records of interest based on multiple weighted criteria.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Spotlight is for record ranking, not visual animations.
Time period highlighting is done through other visualization features.
Export functionality is separate from Spotlight's record ranking purpose.

source.excerpt: Use Spotlight to identify and rank records of interest based on multiple weighted criteria.

questions.question: Which three statements describe benefits of Performance Analytics? (Choose three.)

options.text: Tracks critical process metrics and trends
Measures process health against organizational targets
Identifies process patterns and potential bottlenecks before they occur

explanation.correct: Performance Analytics improves performance by tracking critical process metrics and trends, measuring process health against targets, and identifying patterns and bottlenecks before they occur.

wrongAnswers.explanation: PA complements Reporting; it doesn't replace all reports. They address different use cases.
Dashboards require configuration; PA provides tools but doesn't auto-generate all dashboards.

source.excerpt: Performance Analytics improves performance and accelerates continual service improvement by: Tracking critical process metrics and trends. Measuring process health and behavior against organizational targets. Identifying process patterns and potential bottlenecks before they occur.

questions.question: How can Interactive Analysis be launched for a list of records?

options.text: Navigate to Performance Analytics > Interactive Analysis
Right-click on a column header and select Launch Interactive Analysis
Click the Interactive Analysis icon in the header
From the PA Admin Console only

explanation.correct: Right-click on the header of the column you want to analyze and select Launch Interactive Analysis.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Interactive Analysis is launched from list views, not a dedicated navigation menu.
There is no dedicated icon in the header; use the column right-click context menu.
Interactive Analysis is launched from lists, not exclusively from Admin Console.

source.excerpt: Right-click on the header of the column you want to analyze and select Launch Interactive Analysis.

questions.question: In which phase of PA implementation should stakeholders be granted dashboard access?

explanation.correct: In the Share results phase, you display actionable KPIs, grant dashboard access to stakeholders, and empower everyone to take action with embedded, real-time analytics.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Plan and Prepare is for defining goals, not granting access.
This phase is for activating and testing solutions, not sharing access.
Collect data is for setting up and running collection jobs.

source.excerpt: Share results: Display actionable KPIs that tell the story of your business process and display the right level of information to their intended viewers. Grant dashboard access to stakeholders.

questions.question: What is the Dependency Assessment feature used for in Performance Analytics?

options.text: To check plugin dependencies before activation
To view, analyze, and edit PA components and their relationships from a single view

explanation.correct: Dependency Assessment enables you to view, analyze, and edit your performance analytics components including widgets, indicators, and breakdowns, from a single view. By viewing the hierarchy of components and the relationships between them, you can see immediately who is impacted by a change.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Plugin dependencies are managed separately in System Applications.
Performance testing is not the purpose of Dependency Assessment.
User roles are managed in User Administration, not Dependency Assessment.

source.excerpt: Dependency Assessment enables you to view, analyze, and edit your performance analytics components including widgets, indicators, and breakdowns, from a single view. By viewing the hierarchy of components and the relationships between them, you can see immediately who is impacted by a change.

questions.question: What are Analytics Solutions in Platform Analytics?

options.text: Pre-configured dashboards with all necessary underlying components

explanation.correct: Analytics Solutions include preconfigured dashboards and all necessary underlying components.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Custom scripts are created separately; Analytics Solutions are complete dashboard packages.
Analytics Solutions are native ServiceNow content, not third-party integrations.
Export configurations are separate from Analytics Solutions.

source.excerpt: When the process is complete, consider installing Analytics Solutions, which include preconfigured dashboards and all necessary underlying components.

questions.question: Which aggregate types are supported when using element filters in Platform Analytics data visualizations?

options.text: No aggregates are supported with element filters

explanation.correct: Only automated indicators with the Count, Minimize, or Maximize aggregate are supported in Platform Analytics data visualizations with element filters.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Sum and Average are not the supported aggregates for element filters in data visualizations.
Not all aggregates are supported; only Count, Minimize, and Maximize work with element filters.
Element filters do work with specific aggregates (Count, Minimize, Maximize).

source.excerpt: Only automated indicators with the Count, Minimize, or Maximize aggregate are supported.

questions.question: An administrator wants to clean up old Performance Analytics scores to ensure optimal performance. Which feature should they use?

options.text: Cleaning collected Performance Analytics data feature

explanation.correct: Performance Analytics scores and snapshots may grow over time and should be routinely cleaned to ensure optimal performance and accurate data.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Score Migration Tool is for moving scores between table structures, not cleaning old data.
Data Archiving is a general platform feature; PA has its own cleaning functionality.
Table Cleaner is not a standard PA tool; use the PA-specific cleaning feature.

source.excerpt: Performance Analytics scores and snapshots may grow over time and should be routinely cleaned to ensure optimal performance and accurate data.

questions.question: What happened to the Performance Analytics Scores [pa_scores] table structure in recent releases?

options.text: It was split into two tables to help with processing large numbers of scores
It was merged with the Snapshots table

explanation.correct: The Performance Analytics Scores [pa_scores] table was split into two tables. This structure helps with processing large numbers of scores. You can migrate your scores from the old table structure to the new using the score migration tool.

wrongAnswers.explanation: The table was restructured, not removed.
The Scores table was split, not merged with Snapshots.
The table was split into two tables, not simply renamed.

source.excerpt: The Performance Analytics Scores [pa_scores] table was split into two tables. This structure helps with processing large numbers of scores. You can migrate your scores from the old table structure to the new, using the score migration tool.

questions.question: What can NOT be changed when viewing a personalized visual on a dashboard or workspace?

options.text: The elements filter used to personalize the visual

explanation.correct: It is not possible to change elements filters that are used to personalize visuals when simply viewing the visual on a dashboard or workspace. Only a user with the rights to edit the underlying widget or data visualization can change the elements filter.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Time period can typically be adjusted by viewers through standard controls.
Breakdown selection can often be changed within allowed options.
Drill-down is typically available to viewers with appropriate permissions.

source.excerpt: It is not possible to change elements filters that are used to personalize visuals when simply viewing the visual on a dashboard or workspace. Only a user with the rights to edit the underlying widget or data visualization can change the elements filter.

questions.question: Which two aggregation methods can be used when aggregating breakdown element scores in the Scoresheet? (Choose two.)

explanation.correct: When using Aggregate scores in the Scoresheet, you can choose whether to use the Sum or the Average of a specific breakdown to calculate the main scores for the indicator.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Median is not available as a scoresheet aggregation option.
Mode is not available as a scoresheet aggregation option.

source.excerpt: Choose whether you want to use the Sum or the Average of a specific breakdown to calculate the main scores for the indicator.

questions.question: What is the recommended approach before setting up Performance Analytics on a production instance?

options.text: Set up and test Performance Analytics on a non-production instance
Import sample data directly to production

explanation.correct: Important: Set up and test Performance Analytics on a non-production instance before you set it up on a production instance.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Plugin activation should be tested on non-production first.
Testing should happen before configuring production dashboards.
Sample data should be tested in non-production environments.

source.excerpt: Important: Set up and test Performance Analytics on a non-production instance before you set it up on a production instance.

questions.question: A user wants to try out Spotlight with Complimentary Performance Analytics. Which records can they use Spotlight with?

explanation.correct: Without a license you can only use Spotlight with incident records and you cannot access the Spotlight interactive analysis.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Without a license, Spotlight is limited to incident records only.
Change records are not included in the complimentary version's Spotlight feature.
The complimentary version specifically limits Spotlight to incidents, not all task records.

source.excerpt: Without a license you can only use Spotlight with incident records and you cannot access the Spotlight interactive analysis.

questions.question: Where can a user navigate to try out Complimentary Performance Analytics for Incident Management?

explanation.correct: To try out Complimentary Performance Analytics for Incident Management, navigate to Performance Analytics > Guided Setup and launch the Incident Management guided setup.

wrongAnswers.explanation: Admin Console is for managing existing PA configurations, not the guided intro.
Plugins is for activating plugins; the guided setup has its own navigation.
Indicators lists existing indicators; Guided Setup provides the introductory tour.

source.excerpt: To try out Complimentary Performance Analytics for Incident Management, navigate to Performance Analytics > Guided Setup and launch the Incident Management guided setup.
